login.title: Back office
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your business

hint.FORBIDDEN: Your account does not allow this. Ask a business owner.
hint.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
hint.CONFLICT: Something changed since this screen loaded. Check the details and try again.

noAccess.title: No back-office modules are available to your account
noAccess.body: Your permissions do not currently include any of the back-office areas built so far. Ask a business owner if you need access.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.explainer: Every figure below is computed by the server from the ledger and the sale records.
dashboard.rangeHint: Leave both empty for the default range.
dashboard.limitationsTitle: What these figures do and do not include

claims.title: Warranty claims
claims.explainer: Claims raised at the till are decided here, after inspection.
claims.noneClaimed: No warranty has an open claim
claims.resolveWarning: A decision is final: a claim cannot be reopened once resolved or rejected.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.explainer: Cashiers close blind. The expected figure and the variance are reviewed here.
shifts.reconcileWarning: This records that you accepted the variance. It cannot change the counted amount, and the accounting entry was already posted when the shift closed. A shift can be signed off once.
shifts.alreadyReconciled: This shift has already been signed off.

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.explainer: Products, variants and the barcodes the tills scan. Prices configured here are what the backend charges from.
catalogue.name: Name
catalogue.newProductExplainer: Cost and price entered here seed the first variant. Afterwards each variant carries its own, changed under their own permissions.
catalogue.addVariantHint: A new variant of this product. Its SKU must be unique across the whole catalogue.
catalogue.setPriceHint: The variant's own selling price. A configured price list still overrides it at the till.
catalogue.setCostHint: The variant's cost. Recorded in price history and never shown to anyone without permission to see cost.
catalogue.addBarcodeHint: A code the till can scan to reach this variant.
catalogue.deactivateWarning: It stops appearing as active and cannot be sold. Nothing is deleted: its history and every past sale stay intact, and you can reactivate it at any time.
catalogue.bundleExplainer: What one of this bundle contains. The backend decides what selling it consumes from stock.

pricing.title: Price lists
pricing.explainer: The prices the backend charges from. Editing one changes what the tills charge next; it rewrites no past sale.
pricing.newListHint: A new list starts empty and does not apply until you make it the default.
pricing.name: Name
pricing.noApplicable: No price list is in force. Every sale charges the price the till sends.
pricing.applicabilityNote: A list applies when it is both the default and active. Customer-, branch- and warehouse-specific pricing is not supported.
pricing.promoteWarning: "{{name}}" becomes the list every till prices from, and the current default stops applying. Prices already on past sales are unaffected.
pricing.promoteNeutral: This list becomes the default. It only takes effect while it is also active.
pricing.thisListApplies: This is the list the tills price from.
pricing.thisListDoesNotApply: Prices here are stored but not charged — this list is not the active default.
pricing.addPriceHint: Sets this variant's price in this list.
pricing.editPriceApplies: This list is in force, so this becomes what the tills charge for this variant.
pricing.editPriceInert: This list is not in force, so this changes nothing at the till until it becomes the active default.
pricing.noPrices: No prices configured in this list

setup.title: Setup
setup.explainer: The master data your catalogue is built from.
setup.name: Name
setup.attributesExplainer: Name the dimensions your products vary by — Size and Colour for clothing, Capacity and Voltage for appliances. They are yours to define.
setup.taxesExplainer: A named rate a product can carry. The backend computes every tax amount on a sale.
setup.removeValueWarning: "{{value}}" is removed permanently. Variants already using it keep it.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.explainer: Stock as the server holds it. Every quantity here is computed by the backend; nothing on this screen adds up a balance.
inventory.adjustWarning: Enter the DIFFERENCE, not the new total: positive to add stock you found, negative for damage or loss. This writes a stock movement and an accounting entry, and cannot be undone — only corrected by another adjustment.
inventory.balancesHint: Available is on hand minus anything reserved. Both figures come from the server.
inventory.countHint: Choose a warehouse to start a physical count of it.
inventory.startCountWarning: This snapshots the expected quantity of every variant currently held in this warehouse, so it can be compared against a physical count. No stock moves until the count is approved.
inventory.serialsHint: Every status here is the server's. A unit's location and whether it can be sold are never inferred in the browser.
inventory.lotsHint: A lot records identity and dates only — it is not a quantity counter. How much of a lot remains is answered by the movement ledger.
inventory.integrityHint: Recomputes every cached balance from the append-only movement ledger and reports where the two disagree.
inventory.integrityClean: All {{checked}} balances agree with the movement ledger.
inventory.integrityDirty: {{count}} of {{checked}} balances disagree with the movement ledger.

transfers.title: Stock transfers
transfers.explainer: Moving stock between warehouses. A draft moves nothing; stock leaves when the transfer is sent and arrives when it is received.
transfers.newTransferHint: This creates a draft. No stock moves and nothing is reserved until you send it.
transfers.sendWarning: Stock leaves the source warehouse now. Availability is checked at this point, not before.
transfers.serialsHint: For serial-tracked lines, list the exact units going in the box — one serial per unit, separated by spaces or commas. Leave blank for lines that are not serial-tracked.
transfers.receiveWarning: Books in what was actually in the box, for every line at once. The transfer completes either way; anything sent that did not arrive is recorded as a shortfall, and serial-tracked units you do not list stay in transit.

counts.title: Stock count
counts.explainer: Expected quantities were snapshotted when this count was created. Approving it is what moves stock to match what was counted.
counts.submitWarning: Submits this count for approval. No stock moves yet.
counts.approveWarning: This moves stock to match what was counted, writing a movement for every line that differs. It cannot be undone.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.explainer: Who you buy from, and what you still owe them. Balances are calculated by the server from the supplier ledger.
suppliers.name: Name
suppliers.deactivateWarning: They stop appearing on new purchase orders. Nothing is deleted, and their purchase history stays intact. The server will refuse if an order with them is still open.

purchases.title: Purchase orders
purchases.explainer: Ordering from suppliers. A draft commits nothing; stock arrives when the order is received, and the books move at the same moment.
purchases.newPurchaseExplainer: This creates a DRAFT. Nothing is committed to the supplier and no stock moves until it is approved and received.
purchases.totalsHint: Totals are calculated by the server when the order is created — the figures on the saved order are the authoritative ones.
purchases.approveWarning: Approving commits the business to this order and allows it to be received. It posts no accounting on its own.
purchases.cancelWarning: This cancels the order. Anything already received stays received — cancelling does not reverse stock or accounting.
purchases.receiveWarning: Books the goods into the order's warehouse. This increases stock and posts the accounting entry in one step, and cannot be undone — only corrected by a return.
purchases.serialsHint: For serial-tracked lines, list the exact units arriving — one serial per unit, separated by spaces or commas. Leave blank for lines that are not serial-tracked.
purchases.returnWarning: Sends goods back to the supplier. This reduces stock and posts the accounting entry.
purchases.payWarning: Records a payment against this order and reduces what you owe the supplier.
